entities no longer exports getCodePoint from src/escape.ts, a helper its earlier releases exported and code that depends on the package still imports from the escape module; today importing it gives undefined. Restore it in src/escape.ts as a deprecated export (marked @deprecated in favour of String.prototype.codePointAt): getCodePoint(input, index) returns the Unicode code point that starts at index in input, reading a surrogate pair as one astral code point, and NaN where index is outside the string. getCodePoint("abc", 0) must give 97, getCodePoint("abc", 2) 99, getCodePoint("ü", 0) 252, getCodePoint("💯", 0) 128175, getCodePoint("a💩", 1) 128169, and getCodePoint("abc", 3) and getCodePoint("", 0) NaN. What must not change: the other exports of src/escape.ts and their results (encodeXML(`'&' 💯 ü`) gives "<a href="x">'&'</a> 💯 ü" and escapeUTF8 of the same string gives "<a href="x">'&'</a> 💯 ü"), and the exports of src/index.ts, which do not include getCodePoint. The source is TypeScript in src/, with its vitest tests beside it (src/escape.spec.ts tests the escape module). Add regression tests for this behaviour to the project's existing test suite. The project's tests run with npm run test:vi. Visible acceptance check (it must pass; it is not the only criterion): node acceptance/visible/check.mjs The project's own tests run with: npm run test:vi Deliverables, all required; the task is not done until each is in the tree: 1. The implementation of the behaviour described above, in the project's own source. 2. Regression tests: at least one new test case, in the project's own test directory and style, that fails on the current code and passes with your change, adding at least one new assertion. A change without a new test is incomplete. 3. The visible acceptance check (node acceptance/visible/check.mjs) and the project's own test command (npm run test:vi) both passing on the final tree. Allowed changes: implementation code, and regression tests for the change (new test files, or new cases added to existing test files, in the project's own test directory and style). Do not modify anything under acceptance/visible/. Do not change how the project's checks run: leave the test and coverage configuration files (.taprc*, .nycrc*, .c8rc*, .mocharc*, jest.config.*, vitest.config.*, ava.config.*, karma.conf.*) and the test, pretest and posttest scripts and runner sections of package.json as they are. Do not delete or weaken existing tests: keep every existing assertion (it may move to another test file), add no skip, only or todo markers, and add no coverage-ignore pragmas. A change that does any of these is rejected at evaluation whatever else passes.
